description: Lobbying transparency: the declared interests and mandates of a member of the Federal Assembly (board seats, advisory roles, associations, foundations) with the organisation, the member's function, the type of interest and organisation, and paid/unpaid where published, plus declared occupations. Look up by last name (e.g. 'Noser', optionally first_name) or exact person_number (ID from search_council_members). Examples: {name:'Bregy'}; {name:'Müller', first_name:'Damian'}; {person_number:4057}.
